title: College Football Week Ahead
subject: CFB Week 3: Michigan State–Notre Dame leads 8 games worth researching
preview_text: Widest gap to a book number: 6.0 points on Michigan State at Notre Dame. 8 of 8 featured games carry a book number. Research, not picks.

paragraphs: EdgeDesk scored 75 upcoming college football games for Week 3 and put 8 in front of you.
The widest disagreement with a book number is 6.0 points. 8 of the 8 featured games carry a joined sportsbook number; the rest are model-only reads.

17 games with a larger gap were left out on purpose: the discrepancy was bigger than the evidence behind it. A big number on thin data is the most common way research goes wrong, and leaving it out is the finding.

difference.text: Both numbers above are quoted from Notre Dame’s side, and EdgeDesk’s sits 6.0 points toward Michigan State of the market’s.

why.text: On EdgeDesk’s own ETSR (overall) scale it has Notre Dame #9 of 68 at +7.5 and Michigan State #47 of 68 at -1.1.

why.source: matchups.Michigan State offensive line vs Notre Dame defensive line
why.text: Michigan State’s offensive line rates 42.8 (#67 of 68) against Notre Dame’s defensive line at 59.1 (#5 of 68). Notre Dame’s unit stands higher among its own position group, by 62 places.
Notre Dame carries the wider measured edge on Run defense — 71.4 · #1 of 68 against Michigan State’s 37.3 · #58 of 68.
